fabric-api-base.reason: Shipped by Fabricated (vendored from upstream); every Fabric API module builds on it.

fabric-block-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's block hooks (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); NeoForge's own chunk-section air check is kept; fluid flow events fire where NeoForge lets fluids interact, not when a fluid flows into a new position.

fabric-client-gametest-api-v1.reason: development-time test framework, not needed to play

fabric-content-registries-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated: upstream's registries and mixins, with NeoForge's data maps backed by them where an entry is missing; entity swimming, drowning and boat floating in Fabric-registered fluids are not applied (NeoForge rewrote that code).

fabric-crash-report-info-v1.reason: NeoForge already lists every mod in crash reports; nothing else to provide.

fabric-data-generation-api-v1.reason: development-time data generator, not needed to play

fabric-entity-events-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's entity events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); elytra and most sleep events are not fired.

fabric-events-interaction-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's interaction events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); attack entity callbacks get no hit result, and client-side cancelled interactions still reach the server.

fabric-gametest-api-v1.reason: development-time test framework, not needed to play

fabric-item-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's item hooks and events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); equipment slot providers get no entity, enchantment modify events are not fired, block transformer registrations and events are not applied.

fabric-lifecycle-events-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches).

fabric-loot-api-v3.reason: Shipped by Fabricated: upstream's builder and drop mixins as they are, its loading hook replaced by NeoForge's LootTableLoadEvent (upstream's conflicts with NeoForge's loot loading).

fabric-networking-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's payload system (login queries are not supported).

fabric-object-builder-api-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's registration events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches); custom minecart comparator logic is not used by detector rails.

fabric-registry-sync-v0.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's registries, which already sync ids to clients (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches).

fabric-resource-loader-v1.reason: Shipped by Fabricated on NeoForge's reload-listener and pack-finder events (upstream's mixins conflict with NeoForge's patches).
